Attribute.Name: Master Product Handling Status
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    i:=path(),
    parent:=listitem(
        i,
         listlen(i)-1
    ),
    ParentOT:=iterate(parent, 'StepObjectTypeID()'),
    isAssignedMP:=if(exact(ParentOT, "PMDM.PRD.InternalMasterProduct"), 'true', 'false'),
    goldenRecord:=iterate(referencesto('Product', 'PMDM.PRT.GoldenToSourceRecord'), 'referenceowner()'),
    masterProductIDNode := prodval('PMDM.AT.PDS.MasterProductID'),
    masterProductIDGolden := iterate(goldenRecord, "prodval('PMDM.AT.PDS.MasterProductID')"),
    masterProductID := if(len(masterProductIDNode)>0,masterProductIDNode,masterProductIDGolden),
    hasSuggestedMP:=if(len(masterProductID)>0,'true','false'),
    supplierYESpimYES:=concatenate(iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus1")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),masterProductID,iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus2")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),iterate(parent, 'StepID()'),"."),
    supplierNOpimYES:=concatenate(iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus3")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),iterate(parent, 'StepID()'),"."),
    supplierYESpimNO:=concatenate(iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus1")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),masterProductID,iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus4")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"))
}
concatenate(
if(and(exact(hasSuggestedMP,"false"),exact(isAssignedMP,"false")),iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_MasterProductHandlingStatus5")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')"),""),
if(and(exact(hasSuggestedMP,"true"),exact(isAssignedMP,"true")),supplierYESpimYES,""),
if(and(exact(hasSuggestedMP,"false"),exact(isAssignedMP,"true")),supplierNOpimYES,""),
if(and(exact(hasSuggestedMP,"true"),exact(isAssignedMP,"false")),supplierYESpimNO,"")
)"/>
